name: Impressive Monet & Brilliant Klimt
description: Step inside the masterpieces of two iconic artists. This popular immersive experience uses digital projections to bring the works of Monet and Klimt to life in a stunning display.
longDescription:
"Impressive Monet & Brilliant Klimt" is an art exhibition presented at Alfândega do Porto, focusing on the oeuvres of Claude Monet and Gustav Klimt. The exhibition utilizes digital projection technology to display the works of these two painters, allowing for large-scale, animated interpretations of their paintings. This format aims to provide a different perspective on their artistic styles and individual pieces.

Visitors to the exhibition will encounter a series of projected images that move across the walls and floor of the venue. The experience is designed to immerse the audience within the artwork itself, rather than presenting static framed pieces. The Alfândega do Porto, a historic building on the Douro riverfront, provides a grand setting for this large-scale digital display. The exhibition is suitable for a general audience interested in art and new presentation formats.

The event is ticketed for entry on 2026-08-27. The Alfândega do Porto is located near the river and is accessible by bus lines serving the waterfront area. It is also within walking distance from the historic centre of Porto, though it is not directly served by a metro station.
